title: National Development Council
definition: The National Development Council (NDC) was the apex body for decision-making and deliberations on development matters in India, presided over by the Prime Minister and comprising all Union Cabinet Ministers, Chief Ministers of all States, and Administrators of Union Territories, alongside members of the Planning Commission.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for understanding India's evolution of cooperative federalism, economic planning, and institutional changes. Frequently tested in Prelims regarding its non-statutory, extra-constitutional nature and composition, and in Mains GS-2/GS-3 for center-state financial and developmental dynamics.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of National Development Council.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Planning Commission
